answer.submission_route: Submit online, by email, fax, mail, or verbally through Customer Service. Priority Health runs a three-level process ending in Michigan's external review. Online: Online appeal form on priorityhealth.com; email phmemberappeals@priorityhealth.com By mail: Priority Health, 1231 East Beltline Ave. NE, Grand Rapids, MI 49525-4501 By fax: 616-975-8894 By phone: The number on the back of your membership card (verbal appeals accepted) Deadline: Level 1 within 180 days of the adverse determination; Level 2 within 90 days; state external review within 127 days -- but your denial letter is authoritative.
